title: pterocymbium tinctorium var. javanicum
intro: Pterocymbium tinctorium var. javanicum, commonly known as Java indigo, is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Java indigo include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an antihistamine. The bioactive constituents of Java indigo include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
